name: Tapas & Beijos
description: The daily life of two friends, Sueli and Fátima, whom despite being independent and single women, always feel smothered.

videos.title: The love adventures of Sueli and Fatima
videos.overview: Sueli and Fátima are surprised by Djalma and Flavinha's early return. Jurandir reappears and asks Sueli for a divorce. Fátima wants revenge on Armane.

videos.title: Fátima celebrates her Wax Wedding anniversary and Sueli has a relapse
videos.overview: Fátima invites Armane to a dinner to celebrate her wax wedding anniversary, but he makes an excuse. Sueli suggests they celebrate together, but Jurandir interferes with their plans.

videos.title: Fátima and Sueli are terrified by the threat of eviction
videos.overview: Fátima has to scramble to pay the rent, since she went into debt buying a cell phone. Armane won't lend her the money, so they turn to Jurandir, who makes things worse.

videos.title: Fatima and Sueli have a disagreement with the bus driver
videos.overview: Fatima and Sueli get into a fight with the bus driver, and Sueli ends up with a hurt knee. Outraged, Fatima demands that her friends defend Sueli.

videos.title: When the ex knocks on the door
videos.overview: Sueli runs into her first boyfriend during a walk. Fátima gets excited and convinces Sueli to pursue her ex.

videos.title: Fatima and Sueli's new and old relationship
videos.overview: PC proposes to Fatima. Flavinha is willing to pay whatever it takes to be Fatima's godmother. PC tells Fatima that he has made peace with his ex-wife.

videos.title: Chalita's mother's death
videos.overview: Chalita receives the news of her mother's death and decides to start enjoying life like never before.

videos.title: Helô Siqueira
videos.overview: Sueli, Fátima, and Flavinha struggle to serve Helô Siqueira, a fading actress. Helô tries to convince Djalma that she can promote the store by wearing one of their dresses.

videos.title: Fatima and Armane face problems
videos.overview: Armane's wife suspects he has a mistress and demands extra attention. Upon learning of the situation, Fatima becomes jealous and insists on receiving the same treatment.

videos.title: Valentine's Day to the sound of the Calypso band
videos.overview: Fátima manages to get tickets to a Calypso band concert on Valentine's Day. Since Sueli already has plans, Fátima invites Armane, who declines the invitation.

videos.title: Armane's niece arrives to disrupt Fatima's life
videos.overview: Carol, Armane's niece, arrives in Rio de Janeiro in search of a wedding dress and ends up disrupting the relationship between Fatima and Armane.

videos.title: Caught in the Act at a Poker Game
videos.overview: Armane, Jurandir, and Djalma are going to play poker without their wives knowing. Suspicious, Fátima, Sueli, and Flavinha go to the restaurant and decide to challenge them at poker.

videos.title: Chalita finds a girlfriend at the La Conga nightclub
videos.overview: Flavinha is not at all happy about the opening of the La Conga nightclub and organizes a petition. Chalita goes to the place to present the document and ends up meeting Samanta.

videos.title: PC reappears and causes a crisis in Sueli's relationship
videos.overview: Sueli and Fátima go to the forró dance with Flavinha and Armane. PC saves Sueli from being run over and ends up going along. Jurandir shows up unexpectedly and causes a big commotion.

videos.title: Armane's father is going to live with Fátima and Sueli
videos.overview: Armane asks Fátima to take his father in, and she agrees in the hope that her boyfriend will get a divorce. Sueli doesn't like her friend's attitude and decides to give PC a chance.

videos.title: Cipó do Pagé – Fátima and Sueli decide to lose weight
videos.overview: Sueli and Fátima take “Cipó do Pajé” to lose weight. Flavinha decides to travel with Djalma and the two take care of the store, but the tea goes wrong and they cause confusion.

videos.title: Djalma breaks Sueli's Saint Anthony statue
videos.overview: A rat gets into the store's stockroom and Djalma decides to kill the animal. In the attempt, he ends up hitting Sueli's Saint Anthony statue and decides to put a Saint Jude Thaddeus statue in its place.

videos.title: Flashback recalls how Flavinha and Djalma met
videos.overview: Fátima and Sueli decide to host a dinner for Chalita in honor of Father's Day. There, everyone reminisces about the past and recounts how Flavinha and Djalma met.

videos.title: Jurandir starts dating PC's ex-wife
videos.overview: Sueli and PC discover that Jurandir and Jurema, the dentist's ex-wife, are having an affair. PC warns Jurandir about Jurema's crazy behavior, but he doesn't listen.

videos.title: Fatima reunites with her mother
videos.overview: Sueli and Fatima are surprised by the appearance of Fatima's mother. She is not happy with her daughter's single status and makes malicious comments, but PC pretends to be her boyfriend.

videos.title: An exam and many lies
videos.overview: PC invites Sueli to meet his parents, and Fátima invites Armane to her house. Sueli ends up canceling the trip and invents a lie that is quickly spread.

videos.title: Geise arrives to the delight of the men and the despair of the women
videos.overview: Geise, the new saleswoman at Armane's store, sparks interest among the boys and jealousy in Fátima, Sueli, and Flavinha. Undeterred, they devise plans to get rid of her.

videos.title: Chalita and Djalma celebrate the 50th anniversary of their establishments
videos.overview: Djalma throws a party for the 50th anniversary of his store, even though it's only 47 years old. Mr. Chalita, who opened his restaurant in the same year, also celebrates, causing confusion.

videos.title: Carol causes trouble again in Copacabana
videos.overview: Carol returns to Copacabana and causes a big commotion. She leaves her son in the care of Fátima and Sueli while she goes to look for the child's real father.

videos.title: Jorge arrives in Copacabana to win Sueli's heart
videos.overview: Jorge, the new owner of the La Conga nightclub, arrives in Copacabana and charms Fátima and Sueli. The businessman's charm displeases Armane and Jurandir, who become jealous.

videos.title: Jorge and Sueli start dating
videos.overview: Fátima discovers that Sueli and Jorge's relationship is more serious than she imagined. Meanwhile, Sueli has difficulty accepting that she is in love with Jorge.

videos.title: Djalma has a jealous outburst over Romildo's return
videos.overview: Romildo's return causes problems in Djalma and Flavinha's marriage. Upon learning that his wife's ex-fiancé asked to see her, Djalma has a jealous outburst.

videos.title: Jorge discovers he has a grown-up daughter
videos.overview: Jurandir meets Bia and, charmed, helps her get in touch with Jorge. During a dinner with Sueli, Bia reveals to Jorge, in a not-so-subtle way, that she is his daughter.

videos.title: Sueli loses her aunt and needs to fulfill her last wish
videos.overview: Sueli's aunt, Cotinha, dies and leaves an inheritance to her niece, along with a letter outlining her funeral arrangements. Sueli doesn't care and makes plans with the inheritance.

videos.title: Chalita is disappointed to discover that his wife was cheating on him
videos.overview: Jorge wants to create a new show: "Chalita's Harem." The show tells the love story between Chalita and his deceased wife, Sulamita, and reveals hidden secrets.

videos.title: Bia organizes "Women's Matinee" to help Jorge
videos.overview: Jorge relies on Sueli and Bia's help to get rid of financial problems. The girl tries to help her father and organizes a show at La Conga: the "Women's Matinee".

videos.title: Hotel fire makes newspaper headlines
videos.overview: It's Armane's birthday and Fatima takes him to a hotel to celebrate. Sueli and Jorge end up going too. The couples get involved in a huge mess.

videos.title: Bia is Fatima and Sueli's new coworker
videos.overview: Bia is hired as a salesperson at Djalma Noivas. Sueli doesn't like the news at all and fears her stepdaughter's difficult temperament. Bia becomes Flavinha's favorite.

videos.title: Needy, Armane chooses Jorge as his best friend
videos.overview: Fátima and Sueli go to the beach at lunchtime, but get into trouble. Armane, suffering from emotional neediness, decides to make Jorge his new best friend.

videos.title: Fatima and Sueli decide to get married
videos.overview: Fatima and Sueli begin preparing for Christmas, happy with their relationships. Fatima decides to move in with Armane, and Sueli decides to propose to Jorge.

videos.title: Fátima and Sueli plan a double wedding
videos.overview: Fátima and Sueli finalize the last details of their wedding. Djalma and Flavinha, the couple's godparents, gift them the rental of their wedding dresses.

videos.title: Fátima and Sueli return to Copacabana married and suspicious
videos.overview: Fátima and Sueli return from their honeymoon and find a tense atmosphere. Tavares discusses his client's pension with Armane, and Jorge discovers Bia's secret.

videos.title: Friends face crisis in their marital life
videos.overview: Fátima and Sueli are going through their first difficulties in their marriage. To Armane's dismay, Fátima is terrible in the kitchen and Sueli can no longer stand living with Bia.

videos.title: Individual Decisions
videos.overview: The couples Sueli and Jorge, and Fátima and Armane, feel their marital bonds faltering. Individualistic attitudes cause the two grown men to end up sleeping in the hallway.

videos.title: A Lebanese Man Between Two Couples
videos.overview: An unexpected event interrupts Fatima and Sueli's plans: Chalita falls down the stairs and breaks his leg. They decide to help him while he rests, but end up without privacy.

videos.title: Long-time employee here
videos.overview: Misunderstandings and financial issues cause problems at Djalma Noivas, La Conga, and Rei do Beirute. The whole mess starts when Sueli asks Djalma for a raise.

videos.title: Mother's Day filled with lies and innuendo
videos.overview: Lies and innuendo mark Mother's Day. The presence of Bia's mother in Sueli and Jorge's apartment generates many arguments. Armane, meanwhile, ends up behind bars.
